_source: Production thesis-writer refresh runs, 2026-09-15 (PEAD Specialist). The submit_thesis input each model sent, and the stored thesis row it refreshed. FIVE's save refused stop_basis/target_basis over 240 chars; DOCU's save refused a target with no buy level. Both passed the writer's own check.

submit.conviction_rationale: The PEAD signal is intact — four clean beats, volume-confirmed gap, and guidance raised — but today's intraday breach of the gap-day low ($236.95) with no buying volume and a cluster of insider sales days after the print keeps me off HIGH conviction. The drift is alive but the setup is showing cracks at the floor.
submit.core_belief: FIVE drifts from the current ~$237 level toward the 1.272 Fibonacci extension at $288.57 within 60 days of the September 2 Q3 FY2026 earnings print as a clean +18.4% EPS beat and a raised Q4 guidance (EPS $1.01–$1.13 vs. $0.86 consensus) pulls institutional buyers through the base pivot at $263.88.

edit_triggers.rationale: Keeping 7-day review cadence unchanged — gap-day low proximity makes weekly check-ins the right cadence to monitor whether the drift resumes or the stop approaches.

invalidation_conditions: A daily close below $226.80 — the mechanical stop — confirms the earnings gap has filled and the drift is over, not a temporary shakeout
A guidance cut or material downward revision to FY2026 EPS estimates at any point before the Q4 print, reversing the beat-and-raise signal that initiated the thesis
key_assumptions: The September 3 earnings gap holds as a floor — a sustained close below $226.80 (the gap-day structural low zone) invalidates the PEAD drift thesis entirely

submit.rationale: The PEAD thesis is being stress-tested today: price at $236.57 has touched the gap-day low zone intraday (session low $236.12 vs. gap-day low $236.95), the up/down volume ratio over 20 sessions is a bearish 0.65, and a Loop Capital downgrade to Hold at $250 plus a cluster of insider sales on September 4 have added overhang. The stop at $226.80 remains structurally valid — it sits near the 38.2% Fibonacci retracement at $229.20, approximately 1 ATR below current price, and above the rising 50-day SMA at $224.67. The core drift signal (four consecutive clean beats, +18.4% Q3 surprise, raised Q4 guidance, volume-confirmed gap) is intact and the thesis is not wrong yet — but conviction is honestly MEDIUM given the gap-day low pressure and absence of insider buying. Holding; the stop does the work if the thesis breaks.

catalystFreshness.note: Q3 FY2026 print on Sep 2 was 13 days ago: +18.4% EPS beat, raised Q4 guidance (EPS $1.01-$1.13 vs $0.86 consensus), 2.4x volume on the gap day. Goldman Sachs conference today extends the catalyst window. All four PEAD signal criteria met at the print.

entryQuality.note: PEAD condition was true at the gap (Sep 3); we are now in day 9 post-print and price has pulled back to the gap-day low, putting us at the edge of the valid drift entry window. Not a fresh setup entry, but not broken either — score 1 for marginal proximity.

relativeStrength.note: vs SPY: 1M +5.4pts, 3M +23.2pts, 6M +3.8pts; vs XLY: 3M +29.0pts. Exceptional RS across timeframes, ranking 2/4 in the peer composite.

trendStrength.note: Trend Template 8/8; all four key moving averages (20/50/150/200-day) are rising and price is above all of them except the 20-day after today's pullback. Basing structure over a rising 200-day SMA at $210.74.

submit.stop_basis: Under the 38.2% Fibonacci retracement of the last up-leg at $229.20 and the existing plan stop — $226.80 is 1.0 ATR ($9.91) below current price and represents the structural floor where the PEAD thesis is invalidated by a gap fill toward the 50-day SMA at $224.67.
submit.target_basis: 1.272 Fibonacci extension of the $173.10 (2026-07-08) to $263.88 (2026-08-24) up-leg projects to $288.57; this also aligns with the high-end analyst price target range and is ≥2R from entry ($236.57 entry, $226.80 stop = $9.77 risk; target distance = $52.00 = 5.3R).

triggers.rationale: Price dropped to support level $226.8. Better entry, or thesis weakening?
Beat — possible entry catalyst. Validate before INITIATE.
Miss — entry conditions worsening. Consider removing.
Floor — sell if the price drops to $226.80. Below this the plan is wrong.
Target $290.00 — decide here: take it, trim it, or raise the target.
Look at this every 7 days, counting from the last real review.
Up 7% in a day — strength on a held name. Evaluate pressing the winner (add + raise target/stop) if the move is thesis-confirming, not an exhaustion spike. Approval-gated.
Down 7% in a day — evaluate a pullback-add ONLY if the drop is market/sector-wide with the thesis intact. A company-specific drop is thesis damage: do not add — hold, trim, or exit. Approval-gated.
Up 10% from entry — gain milestone checkpoint. Re-underwrite at the new price: raise the floor to lock the gain in, and arm the next milestone.
Gave back 8% from the high — mechanical gain ratchet. Bank the gain instead of round-tripping it (the IONS lesson: +17% became a loss because no level was ever re-earned).
Down 12% from entry — loser attention. Decide hold-vs-cut deliberately, before the hard stop decides for us.

add_triggers.rationale: Pullback to the September 4 gap-day midpoint ($67.28) — this is the next viable PEAD entry zone that could restore 2:1 R/R. Evaluate entering with stop at $64.16 (gap-day low) and target $78.30 (1.272 Fib extension).

submit.conviction_rationale: The PEAD signal was clean — beat, raise, 2.5× gap volume — but the drift has already run 11 sessions and the stock is above all early-mover sell-side targets. No entry at $72.87 clears 2:1 R/R. I'm still bullish on the direction but honest that the setup's best entry has passed; I'll wait for a pullback.
submit.core_belief: DOCU re-tests its $86.65 52-week high within 60 days of the September 3 print as the 17 remaining HOLD-rated analysts are forced to revise targets above the current price, driven by a confirmed beat-and-raise, IAM adoption reaching 25,000+ customers, and $215M/quarter buyback execution — but a new entry requires a pullback to the gap-day midpoint ($67.28) to restore 2:1 R/R.

edit_triggers.rationale: Target $76 is now within 4% of current price — review whether to set a new higher target at the 52-week high $86.65 or exit the WATCHING thesis if no pullback entry materializes.

invalidation_conditions: Stock closes below the September 4 gap-day low at $64.16 on elevated volume — a filled gap invalidates the PEAD setup entirely
Q4 FY2026 guidance is cut at the next earnings print, reversing the beat-and-raise signal that created the thesis
key_assumptions: Q3 FY2026 guidance raise is durable — Q4 revenue lands $825M–$829M without a warning, validating the FY2026 8% growth trajectory
IAM platform adoption continues to expand beyond 25,000 customers, translating into visible net retention improvement by Q4 FY2026
submit.rationale: The PEAD drift thesis called correctly — DOCU has moved from ~$64 at the September 3 print to $72.87 today, 11 sessions later, on a clean beat-and-raise with 2.5× gap volume. The drift happened; we didn't capture it because the buy trigger at $62.50 was never hit and the stock went straight up. No new entry clears 2:1 R/R from here: stop at the gap-day low ($64.16) puts risk at $8.74/share, requiring a target above $90 — above the 52-week high. The thesis stays LONG/WATCHING, the $62.50 buy and $57.50 floor triggers are removed as stale, and a pullback to the gap midpoint ($67.28) would be the next viable entry. The 17 HOLD-rated analysts still below the current price are the upgrade fuel for a continued drift toward $86.65.

catalystFreshness.note: September 3 beat-and-raise is 12 days old — still within the 30-60 day PEAD drift window. Guidance raise and IAM acceleration are the live catalysts.

entryQuality.note: PEAD entry window (days 1–3 post-print, above gap-day low) has closed; stock is 11 sessions post-print and $2.47 above the gap-day high. No setup condition is true today at a level that clears 2:1 R/R.

trendStrength.note: Uptrend above the 200-day. Trend Template 6/8 — failing on 150-day above 200-day and 200-day rising for at least a month.
